description: The Travel Impact Model is Google Travel Sustainability's published specification for estimating greenhouse-gas emissions from passenger flights with or without cargo. It combines aircraft and route information with EEA fuel-burn tables, distance adjustments and allocation rules. Inputs include origin, destination, aircraft type, seating, passenger load and cargo assumptions; outputs estimate flight and passenger emissions, separating fuel production from combustion. Coverage is worldwide routes with supported aircraft, at flight-leg resolution. The specification is free under CC-BY-4.0; external operational inputs such as commercial schedule data require separate access. A limitation is that this repository publishes equations and assumptions, not an executable simulator. It excludes airport and ground travel emissions and does not include contrail warming. Modellers can implement the documented calculations for aviation scenarios. Pycontrails (platform-pycontrails) provides related aviation-impact modelling. No flight data or external model archive was downloaded.
